I internalized that BS when I was in elementary school (EVERY single adult at the school was a woman and they never tired of telling us how bad we boys were and how undisciplined we were and how poor our penmanship was (and this wasn't directed at me, it was directed at all the boys... Things like "GENTLEMEN! (literally screamed), and I use the term loosely", "God created boys to torture teachers"(catholic school)) and things like that.). It made me hate school and made me feel like I wasn't wanted at school. It was a miracle that I graduated HS because by the time I left elementary school and went to middle school, the damage was done and I simply hated school. Chris
